# Raito (来兎) — Composer and Sound Designer

Information reviewed: 2026-09-11

> Raito (来兎, read “rai-to”; legal name Masaru Kuba / 久場 超) is a Japanese composer and sound designer based in Naha, Okinawa. He has written game music since 1997 and is known for the MELTY BLOOD and UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH series. His catalog has passed 100 million streams worldwide.

## Official identity

- Official name: Raito
- Japanese name: 来兎（らいと）
- Alternate credit: RAITO
- Occupation: Composer and sound designer
- Based in: Naha, Okinawa, Japan
- Active since: 1997
- Company: Founder and CEO of Lisa-Rec Inc.（株式会社リサレコ）
- Official website: https://raito.studio/
- Company website for commercial music in Japan: https://lisa-rec.net/
- Press kit: https://raito.studio/press/
- Complete works index: https://raito.studio/works/

## Known for

- MELTY BLOOD series — composer and arranger, 2003–2021
- UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH series — music and sound effects, 2012–2024
- Double Dragon Revive — composer and arranger, 2025
- SK8 the Infinity — TV animation score, 2021
- Fate/Grand Order Original Soundtrack V — arranger, 2021
- Indivisible — sound effects

## Career facts

- Game-music career began in 1997.
- Catalog streams across platforms exceed 100 million.
- “Gathers Under Night...” has exceeded 20 million Spotify streams.
- Lisa-Rec Inc. was founded in Naha, Okinawa, in March 2010.

## Fields

- Game music
- Fighting-game music
- Anime music
- Sound design and sound effects
- Composition and arrangement

## Complete works data

The canonical works list is https://raito.studio/works/ (English) and https://raito.studio/ja/works/ (Japanese). It contains 29 public project records. Each work has its own page in both languages stating the year, medium, client when public, Raito's exact role and how he is credited. Information reviewed 2026-09-11.

## Browser tools

- All tools: https://raito.studio/tools/ . Japanese directory: https://raito.studio/ja/tools/ . Introductions and guides have separate English and Japanese URLs.
- KEYS introduction: https://raito.studio/keys/ — Browser piano and organ with a metronome, short-take recording and MIDI/WAV export. App: https://keys.raito.studio/ . A completed new take replaces the previous take; export files to keep multiple ideas.
- PITCH introduction: https://raito.studio/pitch/ — Browser guitar, bass and chromatic instrument tuner with a large cents meter, presets and reference tones. App: https://pitch.raito.studio/ . Microphone permission is required for detection; input audio stays on the device.
- Japanese lyrics guide: https://raito.studio/guides/japanese-lyrics-mora/ . Japanese: https://raito.studio/ja/guides/japanese-lyrics-mora/ . Character counts, kana-based mora counts and musical phrasing with original examples.
- Audio loop guide: https://raito.studio/guides/audio-loop-seams/ . Japanese: https://raito.studio/ja/guides/audio-loop-seams/ . CARVE Seam checks, zero crossings, marker-based OGG loop tags and sample positions.
- TALLY introduction: https://raito.studio/tally/ — Japanese text editor and analyzer for character counts, kana-based mora counts, and writing modes. App: https://tally.raito.studio/ . Source: https://github.com/Raito-sound/tally . Text is processed in the browser.
- CARVE introduction: https://raito.studio/carve/ — Browser wave editor with range editing, fades, normalization, loop seam checks, and WAV/OGG/MP3 export. App: https://carve.raito.studio/ . Source: https://github.com/Raito-sound/carve . Audio is processed locally; OGG/MP3 encoders require a network download.

## Site relationship

Raito.studio is the English-language website for Raito’s international game and anime work. Lisa-rec.net is the Japanese-language website of Lisa-Rec Inc. for commercial music, sound logos and music for spaces in Japan. Raito is the founder and CEO of Lisa-Rec Inc.; the two websites describe the same person and company relationship. All commercial (CM) music and sound logos listed on lisa-rec.net (more than 150 works, 2010–2026) were composed by Raito (来兎 / Masaru Kuba) himself.
